_doc: Motedis' levelling foot D19 M6x40 (LFM6*40B19): a 19 mm base 10 mm high on an M6 stem 40 mm long, with a nut on the base and a lock nut along the stem. It screws into a beam's end bore tapped M6. Sizes from Motedis' drawing, the price from its shop page.
name: fitting-motedis-foot-m6-d19

fitting_kind.rule: A levelling foot: screwed into a beam's end bore, raised or lowered on its thread and locked
fitting_kind.source: Motedis, Nivellierfuß D19 M6*40 (LFM6*40B19), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nivellierfuss-D19-M640

series.rule: Sold among Motedis' 20 mm series feet; it fits any profile whose end bore is tapped M6
series.source: Motedis, Nivellierfuß D19 M6*40 (LFM6*40B19), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nivellierfuss-D19-M640

material.value: steel stem and nuts on a plastic base

body_diameter.rule: The base, 19 mm across at the floor (16 mm at its top)

stand_height.rule: Floor to the top of the nut on the base: 16.6 mm

cost.rule: One in a pack of 10: 20.00 EUR the pack with 20% VAT (16.66 EUR without), on the date checked
cost.source: Motedis, Nivellierfuß D19 M6*40 (LFM6*40B19), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nivellierfuss-D19-M640
